C-GROUNDWORK.title: Groundwork
C-GROUNDWORK.summary: Groundwork classifies tasks, delegates to specialist subagents, and reviews outcomes without the orchestrator writing code itself.

C-ARTIFACT.title: Artifact Model
C-ARTIFACT.summary: The four groundwork artifact types—run ledger, RFC documents, session journal, and spec tree—are file-backed records that persist across sessions.

ARTIFACT-R-u6zs.title: hooks/ledger.mjs persists slice id, completion timestamp, and session id when a slice is marked complete.
ARTIFACT-R-u6zs.summary: hooks/ledger.mjs persists slice id, completion timestamp, and session id when a slice is marked complete.
ARTIFACT-R-u6zs.ears: When a vertical slice is marked complete via the ledger CLI, hooks/ledger.mjs shall persist the slice id, completion timestamp, and session id to the run ledger.

ARTIFACT-R-p3qx.title: The Stop hook shall block session end when the active run ledger contains any slice not marked complete.
ARTIFACT-R-p3qx.summary: The Stop hook shall block session end when the active run ledger contains any slice not marked complete.
ARTIFACT-R-p3qx.ears: If the Stop hook fires and the active run ledger contains any slice not marked complete, then the Stop hook shall block session end.

C-ENFORCEMENT.title: Enforcement Hooks
C-ENFORCEMENT.summary: Enforcement hooks mechanically bind CLAUDE.md prose rules as PreToolUse gates, blocking orchestrators and subagents from violating delegation constraints.

ENFORCEMENT-R-wfdw.title: The impl-guard hook shall deny any Edit or Write call from the orchestrator identity on a path outside the two permitted shapes.
ENFORCEMENT-R-wfdw.summary: The impl-guard hook shall deny any Edit or Write call from the orchestrator identity on a path outside the two permitted shapes.
ENFORCEMENT-R-wfdw.ears: If an Edit or Write call is received from the orchestrator identity on a path that is not a permitted memory file or handoff document, then the enforcement hook shall return a deny block.

C-ORCHESTRATION.title: Orchestration Model
C-ORCHESTRATION.summary: The orchestrator classifies and delegates all implementation to specialist subagents and never writes code or edits files itself.

ORCHESTRATION-R-ve7w.title: When the orchestrator classifies a task as non-trivial, it shall delegate implementation to a groundwork:general-purpose subagent.
ORCHESTRATION-R-ve7w.summary: When the orchestrator classifies a task as non-trivial, it shall delegate implementation to a groundwork:general-purpose subagent.
ORCHESTRATION-R-ve7w.ears: When the orchestrator classifies a task as non-trivial, the orchestrator shall delegate implementation to a groundwork:general-purpose subagent.

C-VERIFICATION.title: Verification
C-VERIFICATION.summary: Non-trivial task completion requires an APPROVE verdict from the advisor agent, recorded in the run ledger before the session can end.

VERIFICATION-R-oxuu.title: The Stop hook shall block session end when the active run ledger does not carry an advisor APPROVE verdict.
VERIFICATION-R-oxuu.summary: The Stop hook shall block session end when the active run ledger does not carry an advisor APPROVE verdict.
VERIFICATION-R-oxuu.ears: If the Stop hook fires and the active run ledger does not carry an advisor APPROVE verdict, then the Stop hook shall block session end.

VERIFICATION-R-m5kn.title: When a non-trivial task is complete, the orchestrator shall obtain an APPROVE verdict from the advisor agent.
VERIFICATION-R-m5kn.summary: When a non-trivial task is complete, the orchestrator shall obtain an APPROVE verdict from the advisor agent.
VERIFICATION-R-m5kn.ears: When a non-trivial task is complete, the orchestrator shall obtain an APPROVE verdict from the advisor agent.
